text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ has lost something and
has
enlisted my aid to help find it.
It's not here either! I can't find the notebook I wrote my winning equation in anywhere!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: Where do you usually keep it?

text_block_list.text: I usually keep it right in my pocke—
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Hahaha... Here it is. Well... I must be
more tired
than I thought.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
It's not like her to be this forgetful. The
fatigue
must be getting to her. It might
be time to adjust
her schedule so she
can take a break.
